purpose: Three-suite works-and-installation envelope funded entirely through interest-free shareholder current accounts

scope.warning: The envelope must be rebuilt from current itemized quotes before any commitment.

property_company_SCI.provisional_use: Property-incorporated works and equipment belonging to the château

operating_company.provisional_use: Detachable furniture, operating equipment and initial operating cash

provisional_entity_allocation.quote_requirement: Every invoice must be classified as property-incorporated work, detachable operating asset, operating expense or initial operating cash before the receiving entity and payer are selected.

repayment_convention.annual_approval_process: Repayment is approved separately by each entity after annual closing and review of a rolling cash forecast.
repayment_convention.liquidity_rule: No repayment may make the receiving entity cash-negative or rely on an undocumented transfer from the other entity.
repayment_convention.associate_equality_rule: If a target is paid only in part, repayment is proportional to outstanding principal within that entity unless all affected associates document another order.
repayment_convention.unpaid_target_rule: Any unpaid target remains interest-free outstanding principal. Full repayment within five years then requires a later catch-up expressly approved when cash permits.
repayment_convention.accounting_rule: Principal repayment is a balance-sheet and cash movement, not an operating expense.
repayment_convention.contributor_eligibility_rule: Before transfer, confirm that every contributor is eligible to hold a shareholder current account in the receiving entity. Match the contributor list to each entity's actual ownership and governance.
repayment_convention.validation_required: Written agreements, corporate approvals, accounting treatment, contributor eligibility and individual contribution schedules

reference_cash_test.interpretation: The activity covers the consolidated five-year target, but the provisional entity allocation does not: the SCI is short by 1,000 EUR before existing costs.

allocation_sensitivity.warning: This split is not the active accounting allocation. It is acceptable only if itemized invoices substantiate at least 5,000 EUR more detachable assets or initial operating cash in the operating company.

decision_gates: itemized quotes totaling no more than 80,000 EUR with contingencies identified
restricted schedule of individual contributions and outstanding principal
five-year entity cash schedules showing annual targets and possible catch-up years
collective approval of the investment, allocations and repayment convention

confidential_annex.repository_rule: Do not publish associate names, individual contributions, signatures, personal account details or undisclosed historical balances.
required_contents: contribution amount and date by associate and receiving entity
annual liquidity decision and any deferred target
